title: The Story of a Cyclist, 32 NFL Stadiums, and One Very Important Football
content:
Bond Almand finishes another massive challenge, connecting all 32 NFL stadiums by bike in a 11,000-mile journey crisscrossing the United States.

Read the full article at The Story of a Cyclist, 32 NFL Stadiums, and One Very Important Football on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
